四、映射与辨识核心
placementMode：template-frame
canvasCorrespondence：full-reference-frame
原生完整方图对应参考全幅；最终绘制在该referenceFrame.x/y/width/height，用原global-mask和evenodd精确裁边。不得先去留边、再cover、移动/拉伸/自动旋转、mapFocus、zoom或object-position重找焦点。
subjectCoreInReference建议：{"x":0.535,"y":0.538}；来自构图意图，非实际遮罩验收。
最亮中簇可作为辨识核心，三簇完整关系需实际回拼检查。安全圆不是整幅主角最大尺寸。
当前状态：delivered-awaiting-template-mask-review；actualMaskReviewed=false。
主角、画法和实际参考输入已目视核对，无可见模板轮廓/标记/地名；尚未作网页或行政遮罩视觉验收。

五、文化依据和想象边界
1. 中国天气网：趵突泉
https://www.weather.com.cn/shandong/jinan/jnlyjdjs/07/5025.shtml
支持范围：仅取济南泉水及三股泉涌的稳定景观线索；不复制照片，不沿用2009年的票价、水位、喷涌强度或具体园林布局。

2. 中国国家博物馆：“济南刘家功夫针铺”广告青铜版
https://www.chnmuseum.cn/zp/zpml/csp/202008/t20200826_247463.shtml
支持范围：仅支持济南字号、广告刻版和印刷传播文化关联；B泉涌刻印为原创，非该铜版原有图像、宋代拓本或已核实地方纸艺非遗。
本次已打开上述来源正文；只使用文字文化线索，不复制页面图片。当地来源不等于画中布局真实。
区域组意见：

[本地路径已省略]/济南-首批板块交接.md
泉眼、石岸、荷叶、柳枝、水面布局和喷涌强度均为原创想象；不对应趵突泉实景布局、实时水势、某件馆藏、古代拓本、具体作者作品或工艺操作示意。
B刻印与广告铜版仅为文化创作联想，不把新泉景说成古版内容或已核实本地纸艺非遗。不继承实拍照片摄影署名或许可。

六、已知风险
1. 只完成模板图像参考输入与原图目视检查，尚未由agent5按原SVG实际裁切回拼；模板参考不保证像素级主体位置。
2. 实际左右副泉簇展开比提示的紧凑范围更宽，须检查三簇裁后是否只剩一簇、最亮水形是否跨济南下部凹口。
3. 水墨纹理和水花较丰富，手机市域尺度下需检查是否仍可辨为泉涌而非一般水面。
4. 市名标签可能遮住最亮泉眼；应由组装者按同一frame检查，不改用cover/mapFocus/zoom救图。
5. 未完成四城A组/B组邻区配色、桌面/手机视觉验收；不等于最终艺术或公开地图许可通过。

七、完整实际生成提示词（原文）
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE new full-bleed SQUARE 1:1 Chinese cultural painting, made for a fixed city-template-frame composition. Create artwork, not a map, webpage, poster, comparison board, or diagram.
Input image 1 role: COMPOSITION REFERENCE ONLY. It shows a pale city silhouette inside a square. Keep this EXACT full-square coordinate frame including its outer margins: the artwork's square must correspond to the reference image's ENTIRE square, not a tight crop around the silhouette. Do not zoom, rotate, or recenter the reference frame.
CRITICAL: DO NOT reproduce the reference's pale fill, thin outline, map silhouette, administrative border or blank surrounding field. They are positional guidance, NOT content to paint. Make a natural complete painting across the entire square, including outside the silhouette; the frontend will later clip using an independent precise SVG. No template lines, visible mask, outer map-shaped edge, badges, circular safety markers or labels.
Main subject: ONE coherent broad spring eye with THREE low, vigorously bubbling upwellings of luminous white water. It is an original imagined Jinan-inspired spring scene, not the literal layout of Baotu Spring park. The three white-water mounds belong to the same connected spring, not three isolated fountains or vertical pipes.
Composition in the FULL reference square: put the bright, most identifying foam core around (x=.535,y=.538). The connected main spring cluster can span approximately x=.43–.66 and y=.45–.62, with the strongest white contrast near the core. Let ripple strokes and water flow naturally into the taller upper area and the side branches of the reference, while still painting the whole canvas. Do not bridge the deep lower notch with a complete circular stone pool, long railing, bridge or courtyard. Low-contrast peripheral water and sparse lotus leaves can be expendable when later clipped. No distant panorama that makes the spring tiny.
Only one main cultural subject. A few lotus leaves/water plants are secondary. Do not add a row of relics, a large unrelated vessel or a second dominant building. No actual historical reconstruction or museum object.
Text: NONE. No Chinese characters, calligraphy, inscriptions, signature, seal, numbers, watermarks, logos, labels or UI. No map border, grid, jigsaw silhouette or provincial outline. Clearly handmade illustration, never photography, glossy CGI, metallic product mockup or smooth generic digital wallpaper. No internal panels or comparison layout.

Style/medium A: Chinese INK PAINTING is unmistakably primary. Supple brush pressure, dry-brush flying-white, rich charcoal through five ink tones, wet ink blooming and disciplined washes on visible absorbent xuan paper. Strong white negative brush shapes describe the three bubbling water mounds without outlines of perfect circles.
Palette: luminous paper-white spring foam, deep ink-cyan/blue-black directly around the central water, lighter smoke-cyan ripples and a few restrained gray-green lotus leaves. Keep the brightest spring core substantially lighter than the surrounding ink. Nearby paper and water washes remain varied and alive, not a huge empty white reading zone.
Surroundings: a poetic close-to-medium spring-water view, a few brushy bank stones and leaves in the periphery. No recognizable actual pavilion, railing or copied scenic photograph. Background water and airy ink motion continue naturally across all four edges. The central white water must remain instantly readable in a thumbnail.
Family: handmade Chinese painting, assured large strokes rather than decorative micro-detail. Preserve the full reference-square composition. Do not turn it into a generic mountain landscape or a watercolor-only puddle.
